en: The front of the postcard features a black-and-white photographic view of a harbor and town labeled 'Hamnen. Sundsvall.' A waterfront is shown with multiple docks, ships, and industrial buildings, with a backdrop of hilly terrain. The bottom edge contains handwritten text and a printed publisher's mark. The reverse shows a green decorative border, Swedish text, a 5 öre stamp from Sweden, and more handwritten information.
